text:
isha: quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #8421? It's the tokenizer config + quant profile tweak for nova-lite (model-catalog). Hoping to merge today if CI is green. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/8421  

ci-bot: PR #8421 opened by isha — running CI (unit tests, lint, perf-check).

dmitri: will take a look in ~1h, heads up if there's anything specific to watch for.

cheng: can you paste the local perf numbers? curious if quantization changed latency or memory for 2k seqs.

isha: local quick bench (on g5-16x): throughput +2.1% @ 2k seq, p50 latency ~unchanged, peak mem -3% after int8 tweaks. also tightened unk-token mapping. snippet:```diff
- unk_token: "<unk>"
+ unk_token: "<unk>"
+ normalization: NFKC
```

sara: CI shows a unit test failing: tokenizer/test_edgecases.py::test_unicode_normalization — seems related to the normalization change.

ci-bot: CI status for #8421 — unit tests: failed, 1 job failing (py3.10/unit). logs: https://ci.redwood/8421/jobs/17

isha: pushed a fix (normalize input in tokenizer.encode -> .normalize('NFKC')). PTAL, shouldn't affect existing vocab.

cheng: quick read — config + quant profile look fine. can you add a 1-line changelog entry (models/CHANGELOG.md) describing the normalization tweak and perf note?

dmitri: left one tiny comment about a test assertion, will re-review after that.

isha: addressed comment, added changelog entry, force-pushed.

olivia: ran the failing unit locally — fixed, lgtm from infra side. :thumbsup:

dmitri: LGTM as well, comment resolved.

olivia: merging on green. :rocket:

ci-bot: Merge complete — PR #8421 merged into main by olivia. Deploy pipeline queued (tag: model-catalog/nova-lite@v1.3.2).
